dz: 勇者迈克尔(Michael the Brave),瓦拉几亚王子,在"QȘelimbăr"战役中击败了安德鲁·巴托里(Andrew Báthory)的军队,导致罗马尼亚人民第一次有记录地统一.
de: Michael the Brave, Prince of Wallachia, defeats the Army of Andrew Báthory in the Battle of Șelimbăr, leading to the first recorded unification of the Romanian people.
